Hey everyone! ☕

If you’re looking for a simple, relaxed, pure Vanilla Minecraft server for adults, Lungo Café is open for new players.

We wanted a space where people can unwind after work, build cool projects, and hang out without dealing with kids, toxic behavior, or massive pay-to-win server bloat.

What we offer:

🍦 Pure Vanilla Survival: Standard Minecraft gameplay on 26.2. No land claim plugins, virtual economies, or paid ranks.

🔞 18+ Community: Built for mature players who want a chill, drama-free vibe.

🏳️‍🌈 LGBTQ+ Friendly: Safe, inclusive, and welcoming to everyone.

🌐 Dedicated Hardware: Self-hosted on 24/7 dedicated hardware for low latency and high performance.

How to join: Simply connect with lungo.blue on Java 26.2.
